description: Multiplies a three-by-three block of 16-bit structure values by three weights, scales the products by a shift derived from the scalar input, and adds them to three 32-bit accumulators, using a carried 16-bit path when the shift is negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:298B6

description: Stores the first input unchanged, clamps the second input against a lower bound and adds it to an accumulator, and adds a clamped third input to another, returning early on signed overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:298D0
name: clamp_and_add_value
description: Raises the first input to at least the threshold value, adds the fifth input to it, and stores that sum with two other inputs into the structure, returning early on signed overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:298E2
name: shift_clamp_and_accumulate
description: Right-shifts three inputs by a count, clamps each against a bound stored in the structure, and adds them to three 32-bit accumulators when no signed overflow occurs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:298F8
name: clamp_and_accumulate_three_values
description: Clamps three inputs against bound values and adds them to three 32-bit accumulators in the structure, leaving the structure unchanged if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29904
name: accumulate_direct_and_clamped_pair
description: Adds one input unchanged to a 32-bit accumulator, clamps the other two inputs against bounds, and adds them to the remaining accumulators, skipping all updates on signed overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29910
name: accumulate_direct_and_clamped_pair
description: Adds one input unchanged to a 32-bit accumulator, clamps the other two inputs against bounds, and adds them to the remaining accumulators, skipping all updates on signed overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2991C
name: accumulate_two_direct_one_clamped
description: Clamps the third input against a bound and adds it with the first two inputs to three 32-bit accumulators in the structure, skipping the update if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29928
name: accumulate_two_direct_one_clamped
description: Clamps the third input against a bound and adds it with the first two inputs to three 32-bit accumulators in the structure, skipping the update if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29934
name: accumulate_three_values_checked
description: Adds the three inputs to three 32-bit accumulators in the structure, leaving them unchanged if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29950
name: normalize_and_scale_vector
description: Returns zero unless a flag byte in the structure is set. Otherwise it normalizes three 32-bit components by shifting, derives a scale factor by division from a stored magnitude, adds the scaled components to accumulators, and returns the first component.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:299B6
name: scale_and_accumulate_components
description: When a flag in the structure is set, shifts three input components, scales them by a factor obtained from a nested routine and a division, and adds them to the structure's accumulators with carry into 16-bit low halves.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29A62
name: scale_and_accumulate_three_words
description: Multiplies three 16-bit inputs by a scale computed from a multiplier and a normalized magnitude, shifts the products, and adds them to 32-bit accumulators in the structure, carrying low halves when needed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29ABE
name: shift_and_accumulate_three_values
description: Shifts three inputs right by a count offset by sixteen when that count stays non-negative, then adds them to 32-bit accumulators in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29ADE

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29B20
name: subtract_vector_with_borrow
description: Copies a flag byte, subtracts the second structure's vector components from the first with borrows, and subtracts the calculated results from accumulators after calling another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29B70

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29B78
name: scan_entries_apply_best_match
description: Scans backward through entries with a flag bit set, selects the one with the lowest score, and applies its vector to the accumulators, with a separate path when a flag byte is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29C02
name: scan_entries_matching_byte_pair
description: Scans a backward table of entries for a matching byte value, computes a score for each candidate, keeps the lowest, and adds that candidate's vector into the structure's accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29C34
name: copy_flag_and_add_vectors
description: Copies a flag byte from the second structure, adds the second structure's six-component vector into the first with carries, and adds the results to accumulators in the destination after calling another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29C3A
name: copy_flag_and_add_vectors
description: Copies a flag byte from the second structure, adds the second structure's six-component vector into the first with carries, and adds the results to accumulators in the destination after calling another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29C48
name: clear_flag_and_reset_entries
description: Clears one bit in a status byte and, if that bit was previously clear, walks backward through a table, clearing a byte and writing a sentinel pair of words into each entry whose flag bit is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29C7A
name: select_and_pass_four_words
description: Reads four 16-bit words from one of two offsets in the structure, chosen by a flag byte, and passes them to another routine. A nested routine is called first when the flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29C92
name: copy_transform_words_to_buffer
description: Copies nine 16-bit words from the structure into a buffer, then zeroes two 32-bit fields and writes fixed constants into two other buffer words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29CCC
name: transform_vector_by_matrices
description: Decrements a countdown in the structure, multiplies one or two cached three-by-three word matrices by a stored three-component vector, and writes the transformed components back into the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29DB2
name: subtract_normalize_and_load_entry
description: Subtracts a stored vector from an input vector with borrows, normalizes the difference by shifting until it fits a limit, stores it, and copies four 32-bit values from a table selected by a low-bit field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29DBA
name: walk_chain_subtract_and_load
description: Walks entries until one has a status bit set, then subtracts a stored vector from an input vector with borrows, normalizes the difference by shifting, stores it, and copies four 32-bit values from a table selected by a low-bit field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29E5A
name: store_vector_load_table_entry
description: Stores three 16-bit values into a buffer, then copies four 32-bit values from a table selected by a low-bit field of a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29EFA
name: process_flagged_entries_with_status
description: Sets a status bit, then walks a backward table of entries that have a flag bit set, updating per-entry status bits and fields and writing a sentinel pair when an entry's key byte matches a stored byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:29FE8
name: iterate_flagged_entries_and_update
description: Walks a backward table of entries with a flag bit set, calling a routine for each and updating per-entry status bits, and writes a sentinel pair when an entry's key byte matches a stored byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A00E
name: reset_flagged_entries_to_sentinel
description: Repeatedly writes a sentinel pair into a field of the structure, then walks a backward table for entries with a flag bit set, updating their status bytes and calling a routine for each.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A018
name: scan_entries_and_decrement_counter
description: Scans a backward table for entries with a bit set, calling a routine for each; entries whose counter byte is zero receive a stored word and another call, while the others have their counter decremented.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A046

description: Stores a word from its parameter into the structure, then scans a backward table for entries with a bit set, calling a routine for each; when a counter byte is zero the word is stored again, otherwise the counter is decremented.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A062
name: accumulate_table_selected_products
description: Looks up an entry through a table, selects one of two word pairs by status bits, and multiplies three stored coefficients by the selected values. The products, shifted down by twelve bits, are added to 32-bit accumulators before two routines are called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A09A
name: accumulate_flag_selected_products
description: Clears two status bits, selects one of two word pairs or negates a stored pair depending on a flag, computes three products with stored coefficients, and adds them shifted down by twelve bits to 32-bit accumulators before calling two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A14C
name: accumulate_selected_pair_products
description: Clears a status bit, selects one of two word pairs, computes three products with stored coefficients, and adds them shifted down by twelve bits to 32-bit accumulators before calling two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A1C4
name: clear_counter_byte
description: Sets a counter byte in the structure to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A1CA
name: clear_countdown_and_dispatch_entries
description: Clears a countdown word in the structure, then scans a backward table and calls two routines for each nonzero entry whose status bit is clear.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A1D2
name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Scans a backward table of nonzero entries and, for each entry whose status bit is clear, calls a routine and then a handler through a function pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A1F6
name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Scans a backward table for entries with a status bit set and, for entries whose second bit is clear, calls a handler when two 16-bit fields of the structure lie within fixed limits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A236
name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Scans a backward table for entries with bit zero set. For each, it decrements a counter byte; when the counter reaches zero it reloads it from a second byte and calls a function from a dispatch table indexed by a type byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A286
name: clear_status_and_dispatch_entries
description: Clears a status bit, then scans a backward table for entries with bit two set, calling a routine for each and dispatching through a table indexed by a type byte when that byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A2C8
name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Writes its byte parameter to a location computed from a stored base pointer and an offset read from a byte field of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A2DC
name: store_record_at_flagged_slot
description: Finds the highest entry with a status bit set in a backward table, writes a byte to it, copies a large record of structure words into the matching slot, and adjusts a counter.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A2FC
name: store_record_at_clear_slot
description: Finds the highest entry with a status bit clear in a backward table, and if its index exceeds a threshold, writes a byte there and copies a large record of structure words into the matching slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A324
name: store_record_at_index
description: When its index is nonzero, writes a byte to that table entry, adjusts a counter by whether the byte has a bit set, and copies a large record of structure words into the matching slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A330
name: copy_record_and_initialize_entry
description: Copies a large record of structure words to a destination when the two structures differ, then for a nonzero index initializes normalized values, a flag byte and a table-derived entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A4F2
name: store_record_in_empty_slot
description: Scans a backward table for an empty entry at or above a threshold index, writes a byte into it, copies a large record of structure words into the matching slot, and initializes normalized fields; otherwise falls back to a flagged entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A512
name: store_record_empty_or_flagged
description: Scans a backward table for an empty entry, falling back to one with a status bit set, writes a byte into it, copies a large record of structure words into the matching slot, and initializes normalized fields when the index is nonzero.

name: clear_entry_and_decrement

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A6BA
name: forward_to_nested_routine

description: Checks the table entry indexed by a byte field. If its status bit is clear, it calls a handler from each eight-byte slot whose bit is set and then clears the entry; otherwise it decrements a counter and clears the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A710
name: update_countdown_and_dispatch
description: Notifies flagged slots, then subtracts an input from a countdown word. On underflow it reloads fields from a table and calls several routines; otherwise it updates a second counter, calls routines, and returns a flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A7CE
name: call_pointer_return_one_pair
description: Calls a function selected from a pointer table, then returns a two-part value whose high part is one and whose low part is the input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A7E6
name: set_flag_and_call_pointers
description: Calls a function from a pointer table, sets bit zero of a status byte, and calls another table function when a state byte equals minus one; returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A800
name: process_object_state
description: Updates a shared accumulator from a table value when a matching flag is set, calls pointer-table routines to initialize state fields, and adjusts a per-object counter and a shared counter. Returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A99A
name: return_stack_parameter
description: Returns the value passed on the stack, unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2A9A0
name: initialize_object_and_accumulate
description: Calls a pointer-table routine, sets several status fields to constants, adds two shifted values from pointer-table calls into accumulators, and returns the result of another pointer-table call.

name: classify_value_and_update_counters
description: Calls a pointer-table routine and classifies its 16-bit result against thresholds, updating global counters or per-object fields, then calls a notification routine when the object's flag is set and returns one.

name: move_selected_flag_bit
description: Picks indices through a pointer-table routine and, when a bit is set in a mask field, moves that bit from the mask into a second field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AAAC
name: classify_input_and_adjust_totals
description: Classifies a 16-bit input against two thresholds, updates global totals from a table or clears a per-object word, calls notification routines when the object's flag is set, and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AAE6
name: clear_status_add_table_value
description: Clears a status byte and a long word in the structure, adds a table-selected value to three global counters when a flag is set, and calls notification routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AB1A
name: set_status_add_table_adjustment
description: When a status byte is nonzero, sets it to one and adds a table-selected value minus four to three global counters if a flag is set, then calls notification routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AB50
name: subtract_and_count_threshold_bucket
description: When the input is below a limit, walks a table of thresholds to find a bucket, decrements that bucket's count, increments a total, and calls notification routines when a flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AB84
name: update_object_budget_and_dispatch
description: Scales two speed fields by an input, decrements counters and a budget word by a magnitude computed from the absolute sum of three words and a table value, and when the budget is exhausted either calls a handler or clears per-object fields. Returns the magnitude.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AC6E
name: consume_budget_and_reset_fields
description: Subtracts an amount from a budget word; when the budget is exhausted it resets it, then either decrements a counter or calls a notification routine, and clears three fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2ACA8
name: defer_or_notify_budget_exhausted
description: When a counter is nonzero, decrements it, increments a second counter and adds a fixed amount to the budget word. Otherwise sets a flag bit, calls a notification routine when it was newly set, and clears three fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB8
name: decrement_or_clear_budget_fields
description: When a counter byte is nonzero, decrements it and adds a fixed amount to a budget word; otherwise clears three fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2ACD0
name: set_flag_and_call_handler
description: Sets bit zero of a global status byte and, if it was previously clear, calls a table-selected handler; then clears three fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AD02
name: update_timer_and_dispatch_events
description: Subtracts an amount from a timer; when it underflows it reloads the timer, decrements two counters, and calls routines that either notify or, when a byte field is nonzero, add a table value to three global counters.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0A
name: reload_timer_and_dispatch_events
description: Reloads a timer by a fixed amount, decrements two counters, and conditionally calls routines that either notify or add a table value to three global counters.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AD42
name: consume_status_add_table_value
description: When a status byte is nonzero, clears it, zeroes a long word, adds a table-selected value to three global counters, and calls a notification routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AD76
name: consume_status_when_above_limit
description: Calls a routine and returns unless its result exceeds a stored limit; then, if a status byte is nonzero, clears it, zeroes a long word, adds a table value to three global counters, and calls a notification routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:5:2AD7C
name: consume_status_and_notify
description: Calls a routine; when its zero flag is set it may consume a status byte and add a table value to three global counters, then always calls a notification routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: store_and_dispatch_slot_handler
description: Stores the input word in the structure; if the previous stored word was nonzero, calls the handler of the slot selected by that previous word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_input_word
description: Stores the input word in the structure at a fixed offset.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_normalized_table_value
description: Returns a value read from a lookup table, with the index derived from the input's magnitude through range-dependent shifts and scaled by a shift chosen from that range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_slot_table
description: Writes two fixed constants and a set of handler pointers into a structure, sets the slot count, then calls the initialization routine of each eight-byte slot in turn.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: reset_state_run_slot_init
description: Resets a set of counters and constants, then repeatedly calls the initialization routine of each slot, looping from its input up to five.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: run_slot_updates_fixed_step
description: Clears status bits, calls updates for flagged slots, and when a counter has advanced by at least a fixed step calls the slot step routines with the number of steps; then walks a backward status table calling handlers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: call_handler_if_active
description: Walks each eight-byte slot and calls the handler stored in each active slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: dispatch_by_matching_slot_byte
description: When a status bit is clear, obtains a byte from a routine and calls the handler of the first eight-byte slot whose key byte matches it; otherwise calls a fallback routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: call_handler_by_bit_mask
description: Maps the input value to a bit index using a fixed set of comparisons, then calls the handler of each slot whose flag byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: update_pseudo_random_state
description: Advances a pair of 32-bit state words by rotating, exclusive-ORing with a fixed constant and adding, producing the next value in a pseudo-random sequence.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: compute_scaled_random_value
description: Advances the same pseudo-random state, then multiplies the input word by the high word of the new state and returns the scaled result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_state
description: Multiplies the input word by a value derived from two register inputs and returns the scaled result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_64_bit_value
description: Obtains a 64-bit value from another routine and returns its two's complement negation, carrying across the two 32-bit halves.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: subtract_and_multiply_64bit
description: Subtracts one 64-bit value from another; if the difference is non-negative, multiplies its low word by a 32-bit factor and returns a shifted 64-bit product, otherwise returns the negation of a nested routine's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: multiply_32x32_partial_products
description: Multiplies two 32-bit unsigned values using 16-bit partial products with carries, and returns the 64-bit product shifted left with bits taken from its top positions.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: compute_difference_scaled_components
description: Calls routines for two values, stores their differences in the structure, and computes six 32-bit components by multiplying scaled terms and shifting them to a common exponent.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_and_shift_components
description: Stores three 32-bit inputs directly into the structure, then stores three more after shifting them left by one less than a count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: accumulate_scaled_vector
description: Scales three stored 16-bit components by a factor derived from the input, shifts each product by an exponent taken from the structure, and adds the results to two sets of 32-bit accumulators with carry propagation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: normalize_and_double_result
description: Counts the bit length of an input value, obtains a 64-bit result from another routine, and doubles that result once per counted bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: normalize_to_range_and_double
description: Shifts an input right until it fits a 15-bit range, obtains a 64-bit result from another routine, and doubles that result once per shift.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls another routine and returns the 64-bit two's complement negation of its result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: multiply_scaled_with_sign
description: Returns the negation of a nested routine's result when its sign input is negative; otherwise multiplies scaled components with carries, or calls a nested routine for large values, then doubles the result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: multiply_scaled_or_normalize
description: Multiplies a 32-bit input by a 32-bit factor when the scaled value is below a threshold; otherwise shifts it down, calls a nested routine, and doubles the result the same number of times.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: multiply_scaled_components
description: Multiplies two 32-bit components by a scaled 32-bit input using 16-bit partial products with carries, or calls a nested routine for large values, and returns the shifted products.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_and_round
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values by a 16-bit scalar using 16-bit partial products with carries, returning both products shifted right by one bit to round them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: add_64bit_result_to_accumulators
description: Obtains a 64-bit value from another routine and adds it, with carries, into three accumulator words in the structure together with two stored 32-bit values and two register inputs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two nested routines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:08A8
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two nested routines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:08CE
name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two nested routines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: fetch_table_entry
description: Returns the 16-bit word stored in a table at the offset given by its input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_table_pointer_pair
description: Stores two 32-bit parameters into two consecutive fields of the structure as a pair of table pointers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: set_table_pointers_to_global
description: Sets two consecutive pointer fields of the structure to the address of a shared global data area.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: allocate_indexed_slot
description: If the entry at the given index is unused and a running counter is below a limit, records the counter in that entry, stores the index with the counter value, and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: allocate_slot_from_counter
description: Writes an index byte into the structure and records the running counter with that index, then advances the counter by four; returns the stored counter value, or zero when the counter is at its limit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: write_byte_and_index
description: Writes a byte into the structure at an offset, stores a pair of words into a table slot, and advances a pointer counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: check_bounds_then_call
description: Checks two coordinate pairs against fixed upper limits, returning early if a pair stays out of range after being refreshed by another routine, and otherwise calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: forward_to_nested_routine
description: Calls a nested routine and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: check_bounds_then_call
description: Checks two coordinate pairs against fixed upper limits, returning early if a pair stays out of range after being refreshed by another routine, and otherwise calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: check_first_bound_then_call
description: Obtains a coordinate pair from another routine, returns early if it exceeds fixed upper limits, and otherwise calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:09C2
name: set_status_when_flags_match
description: When one of two flag bits is set in a structure field, sets status bits, stores a state byte, adjusts a second status byte and calls a nested routine; otherwise returns unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:09D4
name: set_flags_and_call
description: Sets two status bits, stores a state byte in the structure, sets one flag bit and clears another in the structure, then calls a nested routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0A06
name: set_flag_and_call
description: Sets a status bit, stores a state byte, adjusts two flag bits in the structure, then calls a nested routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0A32
name: consume_flag_and_advance_countdown
description: When a flag bit is set, clears it, advances a countdown held either in the structure or in a global field, sets state fields, calls two nested routines, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0A3E
name: set_flags_and_advance_countdown
description: Stores an input value in a flag field, advances a countdown held either in the structure or in a global field, sets state fields, calls two nested routines, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0A50
name: set_object_state_and_flags
description: Advances a countdown field in the structure, sets state and flag bytes, calls two nested routines, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0A8E
name: call_when_state_below_limit
description: When a state word is below a fixed limit and two structure references differ, calls a nested routine and, if its result is below a threshold, calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0ABC
name: compute_scaled_entry_update
description: Looks up a table value by an index byte and returns early unless status and budget fields allow an update. Otherwise it computes a scaled value from component values and table data, updates fields through nested routines, and returns the result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0C12
name: compute_scaled_table_update
description: Looks up a table word from an index derived from a status byte, scales it by a 32-bit value, adds the scaled amount to a counter field clamped at its maximum, calls nested routines, and returns the result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0C6E
name: scale_and_add_clamped_counter
description: Scales an input word by a table-selected factor and adds it to a counter field in the structure with saturation at its maximum, then returns a shifted result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0CB8
name: update_entry_with_scaled_total
description: Computes a scaled value from two component fields and an input, updates a status flag, performs a table-driven update, and returns the result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0CDA
name: compute_scaled_entry_with_components
description: Sets a status bit, computes a scaled value from component fields and an input, updates counters through nested routines, and returns a result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0CF8
name: compute_scaled_entry_from_fields
description: Computes a scaled value from two component fields and an input, updates counters through nested routines, and returns a result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0D02
name: store_six_values_and_adjust
description: When a global counter is nonzero, optionally calls a nested routine, copies six 32-bit values into the structure, sets state fields, calls nested routines, and adjusts counters according to input bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0D6C
name: return_stack_parameter
description: Returns the value passed on the stack, unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0D76
name: clear_slot_and_copy_text
description: When a slot byte is nonzero, clears it, updates a counter and state bytes, copies a zero-terminated text constant from a global area into the structure, and calls nested routines before returning minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0DBC
name: set_mine_label_and_state
description: Adds one to a counter, sets state bytes, copies the text 'Mine' into the structure, clears a 16-bit field, and calls nested routines before returning minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0DF2
name: set_missile_label_and_state
description: Sets a 16-bit field to a constant, copies the text 'Missile' into the structure, sets a state field, and calls nested routines before returning minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0E36
name: set_state_and_notify
description: Calls a nested routine, updates two state bytes when a type byte matches a fixed value, clears a word, calls another nested routine, and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0ED0
name: call_and_return_minus_one
description: Calls a nested routine and returns minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:6:0EF0
name: add_signed_fixed_values
description: Adds three signed 32-bit values from registers into the structure's three 64-bit accumulator fields, propagating carries from the high words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:000E
name: select_slot_and_clear_block
description: Compares an index against four stored identifiers to select a slot number, then either clears a block of 32 words and stores the index in that slot, or sets one of four per-index constants and stores the input word for other indices.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:0036
name: select_slot_and_clear_block
description: Compares an index against four stored identifiers to select a slot number, then either clears a block of 32 words and stores the index in that slot, or sets one of four per-index constants and stores the input word for other indices.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:0052
name: select_slot_and_clear_block
description: Enters the slot-selection logic directly, comparing a stored index with four stored identifiers, storing the input word for certain indices, setting per-index constants for indices 14 to 17, and clearing a block of 32 words when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:0056
name: select_slot_and_clear_block
description: Enters the slot-selection logic directly, comparing a stored index with four stored identifiers, storing the input word for certain indices, setting per-index constants for indices 14 to 17, and clearing a block of 32 words when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:005A
name: select_slot_and_clear_block
description: Enters the slot-selection logic directly, comparing a stored index with four stored identifiers, storing the input word for certain indices, setting per-index constants for indices 14 to 17, and clearing a block of 32 words when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:005E
name: select_slot_and_clear_block
description: Compares a stored index with four stored identifiers to pick a slot number. For indices in one range it stores the input word, for indices 14 to 17 it sets a per-index constant, and it clears a block of 32 words when a slot is claimed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:00DA
name: gate_input_and_clear_block
description: Stores the input word for certain indices only when it reaches a threshold, sets per-index constants for indices 14 to 17, and clears a block of 32 words for a claimed slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a2]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a2].adf:Frontier:3:0138
name: gate_input_by_threshold_chain
description: Checks the input against a threshold chosen by a stored index, stores the input word for the matching index range, sets per-index constants for indices 14 to 17, and clears a block of 32 words when a slot is claimed.
